messages:
eva_ml: weaving together a repeatable playbook for calibration + promptbank for the 13B quant bakeoff. want to make it easy to reproduce across GPTQ / AWQ / INT8 / FP8. key constraints first: deterministic seeds, no training-data leakage, and per-prompt gold answers.

samir: +1. also keep calib vs eval separate. calib = narrow, clean, stat-collection friendly. eval = broad, hard, stratified.

rachael: rough sizing proposal: calib between 512-4k depending on algo; eval bank 2k-10k. keep calib small for pilots (256/512) then scale.

miguel: my observations: GPTQ tends to plateau earlier (512-2k), AWQ/INT8 often need 2k-4k for stable scales. FP8 is trickier around dynamic ranges; watch for overflows.

eva_ml: sampling rules we should bake in:
- bucket by token length (<32, 32-128, 128-512, >512)
- stratify by format: instr, chat, code, math, long-context, retrieval
- include paraphrases (x3) for a subset to detect syntactic brittleness
- explicit redact flag for PII/protected content

samir: metrics beyond logprobs: exact-match for closed QA, pass@k/unit tests for code, normalized edit distance for structured outputs, BLEU/ROUGE where meaningful, and a hallucination flag (boolean).

rachael: curation heuristics I've used: 60% common (instructions, summarization, code), 25% rare/edge (long-context, multi-step math), 15% adversarial (repetitions, unicode traps, odd punctuation).

bench-bot: run-tagging convention reminder: --calib-id=calib_v2 --promptbank=pb_v4 --run-tag=13b_awq_calibv2. Nightly job will pick up tags.

miguel: manifest format we should standardize on (jsonl per line): id, prompt, meta_domain, length_bucket, difficulty_tag, origin, gold, redact_flag, ref_type (human|auto). all strings.

rachael: pseudo-sampling snippet I'll put in the tool repo:
```
# sampling pseudo
seed = 2026
buckets = ["<32","32-128","128-512",">512"]
weights = [0.4,0.35,0.2,0.05]
sample_per_bucket = round(total_calib * weights)
shuffle(corpus, seed)
select indices and save split
```
Deterministic seed + saving indices is mandatory.

eva_ml: debugging artifacts to persist: per-layer quant tables (GPTQ), group-scale histograms (AWQ), activation histograms, and a failure trace for each top regression (input + fp16 output + quant output).

samir: acceptance thresholds (suggested starting points, task-tunable):
- short-answer QA: <= 2% absolute drop
- code unit tests: <= 5% absolute drop
- hallucination increase: <= 1.5x
If exceeded, fail bring-up and triage.

miguel: pilot strategy: run 256 and 512 pilots across all quant methods. if no big regression, run method-specific full calib size. Save all calib artifacts with sha256.

eva_ml: operational checklist (compact):
- [ ] produce calib file (calib_{method}_vX.jsonl) with manifest
- [ ] produce promptbank (promptbank_vX.jsonl)
- [ ] run pilots (256/512) and inspect top regressions
- [ ] run full calib + eval bank per method
- [ ] triage and add failing cases to diagnostic suite
- [ ] produce reproducibility manifest (git sha, data sha256, seed)

bench-bot: scheduled: quant-bakeoff/nightly will run both calib_v2 and pb_v4; outputs to s3://redwood-quant-results/{date}/run_tag/

rachael: I'll push a promptbank-generator to eng-ml/quant/prompt-tools by EOD. it will: ingest anonymized corpora, template paraphrases, emit jsonl manifesto with meta + seed. will include a README describing sampling weights and how to add a domain.

miguel: small caution on auto references: mark them as auto_ref and keep human gold where possible. auto refs reduce variance but can mask fp16 systematic errors.

eva_ml: agreed. separate gold_human vs auto_ref fields. also maintain an anonymized publishable subset (no PII, broad domain labels) for external benchmarking.

samir: naming conventions to use from now on: calib_{method}_v{N}.jsonl (method in generic|gptq|awq|int8|fp8), promptbank_v{N}.jsonl, run_{model}_{quant}_{calib}_{pb}_v{N}.jsonl

rachael: deployment note: collect latency, peak-memory, and bytes-per-token for each quant mode in the same run so we can trade off accuracy vs infra cost.

miguel: final reminders: redact PII, persist reproducibility info, and keep a tidy anonymized subset for publication.

eva_ml: thanks team. i'll create the umbrella ticket with this checklist and pair with @rachael tomorrow to finalize sampling weights. reconvene after first nightly. :rocket:
